description: React component for displaying an activity log with loading skeletons and error handling, using react-query for data fetching and Material-UI components for UI. It retrieves activity log data based on provided props like companyId, pageSize, and context, and renders the log or appropriate loading/error states.

methods.name: ActivityLog
methods.description: React functional component that displays an activity log, manages loading and error states, and provides context for child components.
